diagnosis: Reproduce: node --test consumer-enforcement-firing-l34.test.ts reports twenty verify-tdd-range rules silent. Root cause: the test-integrity, baseline, arch-profile, waiver, perf and ci-present enforcers judge fixture marker reports only (SPEC 4.4.1 sample.txt), and ci verify never threads the range base the integrity checks compare against (SPEC 4.10.4, 4.15.1). Probe defects: the head config dropped the language packs (packs []), the fix task never left discovery, the base test held no assertions, the fixture was one line, and no tsconfig, baseline, waiver, budget or workflow was in range.
